tldr: Pluto in the 4th house: power becomes personal through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
body:
With Pluto in the 4th house, this part of you intensifies home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the private base of your life, including the rooms, roots, memories, and relationships that shape where you feel held.

When this placement is supported, your inner life can feel more rooted and easier to live from. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, old patterns can run the room before you have had time to name them. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
